versions.content: The Core Test shall provide an Interrupt Controller and Exception detection test. Especially the detection of an interrupt itself and a branch to a valid interrupt service address shall be part of the test. It is regardless if the test is triggered by software exceptions or by a dedicated hardware unit built in silicon.
